messages:
chris-sales: Quick sync — ACME POC blocked on SSO/SCIM provisioning. They say users not syncing and login failing for some service accounts. Can we triage?
rajesh-solutions: @olivia-iam can you take a look at the SCIM provisioning logs? I asked ACME for screenshots but they saw 401 on SCIM POST.
olivia-iam: Ok. Do we have their SAML metadata + SCIM base URL? need IdP logs too. Also which mode are they using — Hosted API keys or Dedicated pool?
chris-sales: They started on Hosted API keys for quick test, might move to Dedicated later. I have their IdP metadata and SCIM URL from them: https://scim.acme.example.com/. Sent it via DM to you.
zach-eng-platform: Heads up — if they're using Hosted keys and SCIM together we require the SCIM token to be created in the Admin console and not via the legacy key flow. If they used a rotated token the connector will 401.
jordan-acme: FYI we see this in our IdP logs: 
```
2026-03-19T14:07:12Z ERROR SCIM 401 TokenExpired
POST /scim/v2/Users 401 Authorization failed: token expired
```
We rotated keys yesterday but the customer portal/SCIM setting still used the old secret.
olivia-iam: That explains the 401. @jordan-acme can you confirm the SCIM bearer token in your app matches the token we provisioned from the Redwood Admin > Integrations > SCIM page? Also check header is exactly: `Authorization: Bearer <token>` (no extra quotes).
jordan-acme: Confirmed — our app had the old token. Replaced with new one and retried, now we get a 400 with payload error: missing required attribute `emails[0].value`.
rajesh-solutions: That feels like Okta mapping issue. @olivia-iam any SCIM schema expectations we enforce?
olivia-iam: We accept standard SCIM 2.0 but require `userName` or `emails[0].value`. Some IdP templates drop emails if the attribute mapping uses `mail` vs `email`. Ask them to map `primaryEmail` -> `emails.value` or `email` -> `emails[0].value`. Example payload we expect: 
```
{
  "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User"],
  "userName": "jordan@acme.example.com",
  "emails": [{"value": "jordan@acme.example.com", "primary": true}]
}
```
zach-eng-platform: Also note group push requires `groups` array per our docs; not needed for basic provisioning though.
chris-sales: I asked ACME to update the mapping and resend logs. Meanwhile they said web login still fails for SAML SSO with an error: "SP metadata mismatch".
olivia-iam: SP metadata mismatch usually means Service Provider Entity ID in their IdP doesn't match our value. What's the Entity ID they configured?
jordan-acme: They configured `https://app.redwood.ai/saml/metadata` but the screenshot shows our expected SP is `https://redwood-inference.com/saml/consumer`. Which one is correct?
olivia-iam: We recently changed the canonical SP URL for the POC console. The correct SP entity id for POC tenants is `https://poc.redwood.ai/saml/sp`. I'll paste the metadata snippet they should use.
rajesh-solutions: Oof — that mismatch would cause the SAML assertion to be rejected. Can we add a temporary alias to accept their current value while they update?
\azach-typo: (typo, ignore)
zach-eng-platform: We can accept multiple allowed SP entity IDs per tenant but it requires a config flip on the private control plane. I'll make a one-off change for ACME tenant to accept both `https://app.redwood.ai/saml/metadata` and the new canonical. Will do now.
deploy-bot: Requested config change initiated by zach-eng-platform. Change ID: cfg-88291. Status: pending approval.
olivia-iam: After that change is live, ask ACME to re-initiate SSO flow and send SAML trace (SAMLRequest/SAMLResponse).
jordan-acme: Re-tested SAML after you added the alias — now SSO login succeeds for me. SCIM still failing with the missing email but I'll update mapping.
chris-sales: Great. Any blockers on our side for Dedicated pool later? ACME asked about certificate pinning for Private/VPC setup during onboarding call.
zach-eng-platform: For Dedicated/Private we support customer-provided certs and KMS integration. No blocker, but sales should capture required cert chain and network ranges. I'll create a spec doc.
rajesh-solutions: One ask from ACME security: they want a short note showing we rotate SCIM tokens manually and support expiration. Can we provide a one-paragraph to include in their security questionnaire?
olivia-iam: I'll draft: "SCIM tokens are long-lived API tokens issued per-tenant from the Redwood Admin console. Customers can rotate tokens at any time; rotation invalidates the previous token immediately. We log SCIM token usage and provide audit events for provisioning actions"
chris-sales: Perfect. Jordan — can you confirm expected timeline to finish mapping and full user sync?
jordan-acme: Should be same afternoon once mapping updated. I'll ping when users show up in our app.
chris-sales: Awesome. Follow-ups: 1) zach to commit temp SP alias (cfg-88291) — done/pending, 2) olivia to send SCIM mapping example & one-paragraph security blurb, 3) rajesh to capture Dedicated checklist for later.
olivia-iam: Sent DM with mapping example and the security blurb.
zach-eng-platform: cfg-88291 approved and deployed at 2026-03-19T15:03:12Z.
jordan-acme: Confirmed user sync now shows 42 users. All good from our side. Thanks everyone :tada:
chris-sales: Nice work team. I'll add notes to the ACME POC ticket and close this thread.
